messages:
alex: Quick sync: we need a compact, offline-capable contract so proxies can route correctly when control plane fetches fail. Current fetch-on-every-request causes 503s.
maya: Agreed. Do we want a signed short header plus optional full manifest?
sam: Yes. Short header should be canonical fields only: tenant_id, manifest_id, latency_profile, eviction_tier, sensitive_flag, expiry, key_id, sig. Keep under ~512 bytes.
jing: For private deployments the manifest should be bundled with the instance (local file) and proxies should prefer local bundle > header > registry fetch.
alex: On overrides: control plane issues short-lived override tokens (JWT) that gateways attach. Proxies validate token and apply runtime overrides but only for non-security fields. Sensitive_flag is immutable unless rekeyed.
maya: Signature rotation: publish new key, sign with new key, keep old key in trust bundle for 24h overlap by default. Document rotation window and trust-bundle update mechanics.
sam: Eviction buckets map to cluster-local numeric priorities. Keep manifest stable; let cluster ops map tiers to weights via a local policy file.
jing: Also add allowed_hosting_modes in manifest to prevent private-sensitive tenants from falling back to hosted-only models.
ops-bot: Created infra ticket: infra/compact-manifest-contract, assign infra and proxy teams.
alex: Action items: alex write spec + example headers; sam build small proxy conformance tests (signature, expiry, rotation); jing document private bundle layout and trust bundle flow. Revisit in 48h.
